personal.summary: Computer Science graduate student at Purdue University Northwest (GPA 4.0) with a strong background in research-driven software development, data systems, and immersive technologies. Valedictorian graduate with hands-on experience in Java, Python, SQL, Docker, and distributed systems through funded European research projects. Published researcher in VR/HCI and electromagnetic measurement studies, with proven ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams and translate research into working systems.

projectsIntro: A selection of academic projects completed at educational institutions, some of which are not publicly available due to institutional restrictions, and personal projects that can be shared on request.

projects.title: Postgres & Chill
projects.description: A data-driven movie recommender that uses user ratings to generate personalized suggestions.

projects.title: Frequent Collaboration Patterns Mining
projects.description: Processed researchers’ publications to find collaboration patterns between them.

projects.title: Trending Videos Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed data on the latest trending YouTube videos with MongoDB aggregation pipelines, with data conversion and visualization of the results.

projects.title: ASTERAS
projects.tagline: Search engine for researchers based on their bibliography
projects.description: Indexes and searches researchers’ BibTeX files with the Apache Lucene library, with a graphical interface.

projects.title: Transaction Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed an e-commerce fashion company’s transactions by running MapReduce jobs, including a local HDFS setup and visualization of the results.

projects.title: Rayleigh Channel Simulation
projects.tagline: 1, 2 and 4 Rayleigh channels with a rake receiver
projects.description: Simulated Rayleigh channel behavior with AWGN and reception through a rake receiver: BER, SER, eye diagram and constellation chart.

projects.title: GooseGame
projects.description: A simulation of the board game with terminal input, simple terminal graphics and all the moves of the actual game.

projects.title: Stray Animal Shelter App
projects.description: GUI design for a stray animal shelter organization’s mobile app.

projects.title: Social Network Users and Their Activity on POIs
projects.description: Designed the entity-relationship model, implemented it in the database, and built a simple web application to run fixed queries and add or delete data.

projects.title: Boolean Search Engine for Text Documents
